answers.ask: Are the four eras separate places you teleport into, or regions of one continuous map? That is the difference between one build and five.
answers.answer: Las cuatro eras son lugares separados a los que se viaja mediante los portales gigantes desbloqueables desde el laboratorio/base del presente.

answers.ask: How big is each era - a single themed clearing, or a full explorable region?
answers.answer: Cada era debe ser una zona temática compacta y claramente explorable, no una región enorme; basta con espacio para recolectar, su portal y las Cápsulas del Tiempo.

scene_prompt: Crea un mapa 3D de simulador de viaje en el tiempo centrado en un laboratorio/base destruido del presente, con una máquina del tiempo averiada y grandes portales desbloqueables que conducen a cuatro zonas separadas. Cada era es una zona temática compacta y claramente explorable, con espacio de recolección, su portal y Cápsulas del Tiempo: un valle prehistórico con dinosaurios gigantes, volcanes y energía de ámbar; un Antiguo Egipto con pirámides, oasis y energía mística; una era medieval con castillos imponentes, caballeros y magia antigua; y un futuro ciberpunk con ciudad de neón, autos voladores y energía de plasma.
agent_notes: Absorb scattered particles, sell them at your base, buy faster tools and bigger backpacks, unlock the next zone, then rebirth for permanent multipliers — that is the Roblox collect-and-sell simulator loop exactly, so Simulation with the Incremental Simulator preset and no second genre; the time-travel eras are theme on top of it. I kept the preset's social-hub as the lab base where energy is sold and tools, backpacks and Time Capsules are bought, gate-progression as the giant portals that open when you can afford them, path-circulation between base and collecting ground, and added collectible-nodes for the glowing particles the loop is built on and trigger-rebirth for the Paradox pad. The shape is where I left the preset: the author answered outright that the four eras are separate places travelled to by portal rather than regions of one map, so world-open is wrong and I took hub-portals from the catalogue instead — it is not in Simulation's typical list, and it routes P4, which the author's answer earns rather than assumes. Deciding without a user: that means five compact builds, the present-day ruined lab plus one themed collecting zone per era, each just big enough for its particles, its portal and its capsule stand as the scale answer asked; P4 is not a ready route, so the lab is the build to start from and the eras queue behind it, and pyramids, volcanoes and neon towers stay as per-zone dressing rather than enterable interiors, keeping this off P3.
